summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial information for the period ended March 31, 2026, including reviewed parent and consolidated financial statements and notes. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, not a special situation filing. It does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The document is entirely standard earnings disclosure with no transactional or corporate event triggers. No deal terms or unusual items are present.
